reviews.author: David Allison
reviews.text: GreenGuard has changed my life. GreenGuard has turned my back yard into the sanctuary that I have always wanted. They maintain our mosquito traps on a monthly basis and the result is that my family is able to fully use the backyard anytime of year, anytime of day. Effective mosquito control is not a myth. With the right traps and the right maintenance plan, mosquitos can be completely controlled.

reviews.author: Brendan
reviews.text: Very happy with the experience so far with GreenGuard — I was blown away at the amount of mosquitoes that were caught. It was in the thousands. The amount of mosquitoes has gone down considerably, and the guys make it so easy to work with them.

reviews.author: Betny Townsend
reviews.text: We love GreenGuard's service. We've gotten so many of our neighbors to sign up you'd think we were on the payroll. For a lot of folks in our circle, anything that harms pollinators is a non-starter, and this has been the best thing we've tried by far for mosquitos. It's sooo satisfying to look at the bag of trapped mosquitoes after it's rained. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jim S
reviews.text: Great service, really hammers the mosquitos.
